canonicalIdentity.canonicalObjective: Creer des labels historiques pour les zones de creux, sommets, fortes hausses, fortes baisses, reprises, capitulations, accumulations, distributions, continuations et faux signaux.

canonicalObjectiveBinding.rule: byte-identical to the registry; no normalization, no translation, no re-accentuation

canonicalIdentity.strategicPurpose: Create outcome labels that may use future data only as the target definition while preserving a future-free historical feature boundary.

ownerDecisions.subject: contract structure
ownerDecisions.decision: Route R-B ratified: the Consumption Boundary domain becomes contractual. Coverage is exactly seven domains, in order: Temporal Boundary and Horizon Policy, Outcome Persistence, Identity Model, PriceBasis, Dataset Separation, Taxonomy V1, Consumption Boundary. Always exactly 7 contracts. No 8th contract.

ownerDecisions.subject: instrument identity
ownerDecisions.decision: Direct pin. GATE22 explicitly reuses instrumentIdentityV1 as the canonical source of instrument identity, of the ticker != identity rule, and of content-addressed identity. Transitive resolution alone is not sufficient.

ownerDecisions.subject: GATE21 pins
ownerDecisions.decision: Use consumesGate21Pins[] and not a single-value field. The field may hold several pins. Values must stay inside the authorized GATE21 vocabulary.

ownerDecisions.subject: PriceBasis
ownerDecisions.decision: adjustmentTypes is the mandatory pin. marketDataPriceBases is not used because it does not cover TOTAL_RETURN_ADJUSTED. PriceBasis V1 is RAW, SPLIT_ADJUSTED, TOTAL_RETURN_ADJUSTED. DERIVED_ADJUSTED is refused in strict V1.

ownerDecisions.subject: missingness
ownerDecisions.decision: OutcomeStatus and MissingReasons are separated. OutcomeStatus is RESOLVED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, FAIL_CLOSED. MissingReasons carries the detailed technical cause. No new historical status is created.

ownerDecisions.subject: instrument identity promotion
ownerDecisions.decision: Additive promotion of instrumentIdentityV1 as a directly governed dependency. GATE22 keeps ticker != identity. InstrumentIdentityId stays the canonical source of identity. No parallel field consumesLabContractsDirect[]. No secondary authority. consumesGate21Pins[] reflects the dependency after promotion.

ownerDecisions.subject: outcome missing reason
ownerDecisions.decision: OutcomeMissingReason is a structure internal to GATE22_OUTCOME_PERSISTENCE_V1. It is not a new contract, not a new historical status, not a new primitive. OutcomeStatus stays at 3 values; the reason carries the detailed technical cause; the historical status stays immutable.

ownerDecisions.subject: registry compatibility
ownerDecisions.decision: Projection fortes hausses to CONTINUATION and fortes baisses to DRAWDOWN, without modifying Taxonomy V1. Taxonomy V1 stays exactly NEW_LOW, NEW_HIGH, RECOVERY, CONTINUATION, DRAWDOWN, RANGE. CAPITULATION, ACCUMULATION, DISTRIBUTION, FALSE_SIGNAL stay deferred as future FormulaId or annotations.

ownerDecisions.subject: permanently incompletable outcome window
ownerDecisions.decision: An Outcome window that can never be completed because of permanent data absence produces no historical Outcome. No OutcomeId is created. OUTCOME_WINDOW_TRUNCATED_BY_DATASET_END must not create a contradiction with the closed OutcomeId and the mandatory DatasetId_outcome.

ownerDecisions.subject: form of the instrumentIdentityV1 promotion
ownerDecisions.decision: Option B ratified. No GATE21 historical mutation. No change to GATE21 LAB_SCHEMA_PINS. No change to GATE21_BINDING_V1. No change to R0001-R0005. No change to research/directional-lab. PROMO-1 will be carried later by a GATE22-owned successor surface. This mandate does not execute PROMO-1.
ownerDecisions.supersedes: the earlier described WRAP promotion executed inside the GATE21 surfaces under a GEE post-freeze maintenance ceremony

gate21DependencyPreconditions.additiveRule: append-only; no deletion; no destructive rename; no retroactive modification of existing identities
gate21DependencyPreconditions.i12Interaction: NONE. instrumentIdentityV1 is not declared in any consumesGate21Pins array, so I-12 holds literally and unconditionally on the frozen 27-key LAB_SCHEMA_PINS vocabulary. The GATE22 consumption of instrumentIdentityV1 is declared in the separate consumesGate22SuccessorPins namespace, which I-12 does not govern.
gate21DependencyPreconditions.declaredNotClaimed: This mandate declares PROMO-1 as an unmet precondition. It does not assert that PROMO-1 has been executed and it does not assert that START is authorized.

contracts.purpose: T = SessionDate; KnowledgeCutoff is distinct; Observation requires availableAt <= KnowledgeCutoff; the Outcome window is (T, T+H]; H is a session count; HorizonId is content-addressed against the pinned calendar registry.

sessionCountingRules.countingBasis: sessions present in the bound calendar registry; both sessionKind values count as 1 when admitted by allowedSessionKinds

contracts.purpose: Outcome persistence and missingness routing. Before the Outcome Dataset asOf is reached no Outcome record and no OutcomeId exist. After it, the record carries RESOLVED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA or FAIL_CLOSED. Append-only, no historical mutation. Hosts the internal OutcomeMissingReason structure ratified by B-2.

outcomeStatus.notYetResolvedRepresentation: absence of an Outcome record, never a stored value

outcomeMissingReason.inputCause: value of MissingReasonsV1 (GATE21 pin) or null
outcomeMissingReason.windowCause: value of OutcomeWindowCause/1 (local to C2) or null
outcomeMissingReason.resolvedIffReasonIsNull: OutcomeStatus === RESOLVED if and only if OutcomeMissingReason === null

retired.reason: its instantiation would require knowing the future non-arrival of data, which is a latent NO_FUTURE_LEAKAGE violation and, under the C-2 asOf rule, dead vocabulary

nonEmissionRule.rule: No Outcome record and no OutcomeId exist while the C5 asOf is not reached, whether the absence is temporary or permanent.
nonEmissionRule.note: the system never has to decide whether the data will arrive one day; temporary and permanent absence receive the same treatment, which is why no settlement bound is required and no new rule enters the mandate

contracts.purpose: Content-addressed identity model. InstrumentIdentityId is the single canonical source of instrument identity; ticker != identity; FormulaId is behavior and a behavioral change produces a new identity. C3 owns the composition rule, not the source vocabularies.

identityDigestRules.closureRule: EXACT_ONLY: no optional field, no interpretable field, no implicit extension, no at-minimum reading
identityDigestRules.readingPrinciple: the OutcomeId identifies the question asked, never the answer; status and reason are therefore excluded, which is the generalization of B-2
identityDigestRules.horizonIdNotInObservationId: an Observation is horizon-free and serves several H, consistent with C1
identityDigestRules.formulaIdRule: FormulaId is behavior; a behavioral change produces a new identity
identityDigestRules.shareClassRepresentation: distinct share classes are distinct identities carrying distinct identitySeed values and their own aliases; there is no shareClass field in the lab and none is assumed

contracts.purpose: Price basis admissibility and stability across the window. PriceBasis V1 is adjustmentTypes minus DERIVED_ADJUSTED. The same basis is mandatory from T to T+H; a mixture is FAIL_CLOSED.

priceBasisV1.membershipModality: full members, none optional, none hypothetical
priceBasisV1.noRelabeling: an unsupported or derived basis can never be relabeled to another basis, neither at load, nor at computation, nor at persistence
priceBasisV1.availabilityFact: corporateActionTreatments attests RAW_SOURCE_UNTRANSFORMED and PROVIDER_SPLIT_ADJUSTED_UNTRANSFORMED only; this is an availability fact, not a reservation on membership; a basis unavailable for a window routes to PRICE_BASIS_UNAVAILABLE_FOR_WINDOW and FAIL_CLOSED

contracts.purpose: Observation Dataset and Outcome Dataset are separate. Vintages never mix. The Outcome Dataset asOf is a deterministic function of the bytes, never a build-time choice. A restatement produces a new DatasetId and leaves the prior Outcome unchanged.

vintageRules.outcomeDataset: historical snapshot of the window (T, T+H]
vintageRules.noVintageMixing: a DatasetId binds exactly one vintage
vintageRules.restatement: new DatasetId; the prior Outcome is unchanged
vintageRules.enforcementPoint: a vintage violation is refused at dataset construction, not at window resolution; the DatasetId cannot be bound, so no OutcomeWindowCause is required for it

outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.sessionSet: the sessions of (T, T+H] enumerated by the pinned calendar registry (calendarRegistryManifestId, C1), a closed and finite set
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.settlingInstant: availableAt of the INITIAL_ROOT revision of the bar of that session
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.asOf: max over the sessionSet of settlingInstant, equivalently the first instant at which every bar of (T, T+H] has availableAt <= asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.outcomeDataset: the GATE21 snapshot defined at that asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.asOfIsDerivedNeverStored: DatasetSnapshotCore/1 and DatasetSnapshotRecord/1 carry no as-of field and need none; the instant is derived and the snapshot stays content-addressed
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.emissionInstant: at the asOf, not at horizon expiry; DatasetId_outcome is a mandatory member of a closed tuple so no OutcomeId can be struck before the asOf
outcomeDatasetAsOfRule.attestationQualityNote: determinism of the instant is bounded by knowledgeMode; under CAPTURE_TIME_ONLY the availableAt is a capture rather than an attested publication; declared availability fact, not a reservation on the rule
